Main.dc.html.title: Tap-through: Today · Cook · Eat · Train · Live workout

how.text:
Tap the tabs at the bottom. On Today or Train, tap Start workout, tick a set to see the rest timer, then Finish. On Eat, tap Log food and pick something. On Cook, switch Recipes / This week / List.

Sample numbers on Eat are for the mockup only.

eat.text:
Try: tap a chip under YOU USUALLY HAVE (one tap, then Undo). Tap the log bar to see typed food read back with steppers. Tap any logged food to change the amount. Tap Ate it on the planned dinner.

All numbers are a sample day.
